Inference

.. py:module:: graph_recc_sys.engine_modules.inference

.. py:class:: Inference() :module: graph_recc_sys.engine_modules.inference

Bases: :py:class:~graph_recc_sys.utils.config.DataClass

Helper class for model inference and top-k recommendation generation.

This class computes user-to-item recommendation candidates starting from node embeddings produced by the model encoder. It supports similarity-based ranking through matrix multiplication and can exclude already-observed user-item edges from the candidate set.

The main workflow is:

  1. encode the heterogeneous graph with the model

  2. extract user and item embeddings

  3. compute similarity scores between all users and all items

  4. mask excluded edges

  5. return the top-k item indices for each user

.. attribute:: user_name

  Name of the user node type inherited from `DataClass`.

  :type: str

.. attribute:: item_name

  Name of the item node type inherited from `DataClass`.

  :type: str

.. py:method:: Inference.mips_search(query_emb: ~torch.Tensor, dst_emb: ~torch.Tensor, k: int, similarity: str, exclude_links: ~torch_geometric.edge_index.EdgeIndex | ~torch.Tensor | None = None) :module: graph_recc_sys.engine_modules.inference :staticmethod:

  Perform top-k retrieval over destination embeddings for each query
  embedding using a similarity score matrix.

  If `similarity == "cosine"`, both query and destination embeddings are
  L2-normalized before scoring. In that case, matrix multiplication is
  equivalent to cosine similarity.

  Otherwise, the method uses raw dot-product scores:

  $$
  S = Q D^T
  $$

  where:
  - $$Q$$ is the query embedding matrix
  - $$D$$ is the destination embedding matrix

  Excluded edges are masked by setting their score to $$-\infty$$ before
  top-k extraction.

  :param query_emb: Query embedding matrix of shape `(num_queries, embedding_dim)`.
  :type query_emb: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\``
  :param dst_emb: Destination embedding matrix of shape `(num_items, embedding_dim)`.
  :type dst_emb: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\``
  :param k: Number of top items to retrieve for each query.
  :type k: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`int\``
  :param similarity: Similarity type. If `"cosine"`, embeddings are normalized before
                     scoring. Otherwise, raw dot product is used.
  :type similarity: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`str\``
  :param exclude_links: Optional tensor of shape `(2, num_excluded_edges)` containing
                        `(row, col)` pairs to mask from the score matrix.
  :type exclude_links: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch\_geometric.edge\_index.EdgeIndex\` \| \:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\` \| \:py\:obj\:\`None\``

  :returns:     Tensor of top-k predicted item indices with shape
                `(num_queries, k)`.

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\``

.. py:method:: Inference.test_epoch_dist(model: ~torch.nn.modules.module.Module, subgraph: ~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData, exclude_links: ~torch_geometric.edge_index.EdgeIndex, device: ~torch.device, similarity: str, k: int) :module: graph_recc_sys.engine_modules.inference

  Run full-graph inference on a subgraph and return top-k item
  recommendations for each user.

  The method:
  1. moves the subgraph and exclusion links to the target device
  2. encodes the graph with the model
  3. extracts user and item embeddings
  4. performs top-k retrieval with exclusion masking

  :param model: Trained recommendation model. It must expose an `encoder()`
                method returning a dictionary of node embeddings.
  :type model: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.nn.modules.module.Module\``
  :param subgraph: Graph used for inference.
  :type subgraph: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch\_geometric.data.hetero\_data.HeteroData\``
  :param exclude_links: User-item edges to exclude from the recommendation candidates.
  :type exclude_links: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch\_geometric.edge\_index.EdgeIndex\``
  :param device: PyTorch device used for inference.
  :type device: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.device\``
  :param similarity: Similarity metric used for ranking.
  :type similarity: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`str\``
  :param k: Number of top recommendations to return per user.
  :type k: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`int\``

  :returns:     Tensor of predicted item indices with shape `(num_users, k)`.

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\``
